name: hey
description: Hey — dating app. Single Node process serves API + WS + SPA. Builds web/, copies to backend/public/, runs Nest.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix web install --include=dev
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web run build && node scripts/copy-web-build.mjs
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:web && npm run build:backend && npm run db:deploy
scripts.db:deploy:inner: npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
